Working principles

Make risk understandable. Make controls usable.

Good security engineering creates evidence teams can act on-and leaders can use to make sound decisions.

Start with the path

Trace identities, data, systems, and dependencies to understand what can happen.

Prioritize exposure

Connect findings to likelihood, impact, and controls that can change the outcome.

Design for operations

Build alerting and policies that work with real teams and business constraints.

Validate the result

Test the control, document what changed, and show remaining gaps.
